LS-01.boundary: Randomized comparison supports better reading proficiency in this population; no broader claim.

LS-02.boundary: In-vitro cell kill does not establish treatment of patients (species/population transfer); expected derived label mechanism_vs_evidence or overclaim.

LS-03.boundary: LDL reduction component supported; heart-attack component not measured (no events tracked), so the AND claim is not supported.

LS-04.boundary: Reading-progress alternative supported by the randomized trial; absenteeism not addressed. A correct OR is supported if one alternative is supported. Disputed: whether an unaddressed OR component is treated as nonmaterial.

LS-05.boundary: No serious adverse events in 60 people over four weeks neither establishes nor refutes long-term liver damage; absence of evidence is not refutation.

LS-06.boundary: Observational association favours breakfast eaters; RCT meta-analysis found no weight loss from assigned breakfast. Causal weight-loss claim is contradicted by the randomized evidence; conflict may trigger review.
